One writer and one publication per node per poll. Both numerical slots remain valid until dispatch completion; no overlapping polls or structural writers.

Independent long-double rational/first-moment references and observed pre/post packets; f64 error bounds are comparison checks, never sleep/activity thresholds. Quantized coordinates require the exact cell.
Fixed expressed calculation trees and distinct field ownership; compatible source overlap is allowed, anonymous grouping is outside this subset.
Source fixture body perturbations occur between polls and are not production motion/admission. One inert source-only tick is a negative lifecycle control; no coupled physical settling claim.
Full candidate queries are explicit initialization or selected frozen reference operations, not a per-poll solver.

Linked C++ new/new[] and known native counters exclude arbitrary malloc, drivers, residency and page faults. Typed steady payload excludes fixed object/header/compiler storage and reference stack scratch. Source construction temporaries occur during setup.
Test inspection/diagnostic clearing scans do not select work. All source validation/fixture data and source snapshot copies are separate from publication buffers. Host vectors are unpinned.
No density/region width selector, inherited force, new precision ladder, database/cache-manager/analyst implementation. #172/#177/#156/#145 remain open.
